thread.title: The Dow Rises 123 Points Because Strong Earnings Trump Everything

title: The Dow Rises 123 Points Because Strong Earnings Trump Everything
text:
The Dow Rises 123 Points Because Strong Earnings Trump Everything By Jan. 16, 2019 12:00 p.m. ET Order Reprints Michael Haddad Text size
Earnings to the Rescue . Stocks are rising on Wednesday as good news from corporate America helped to overshadow global uncertainty after the British parliament rejected Prime Minister Theresa May’s Brexit deal. While worries about global growth still lurk, upbeat earnings reports–especially from Dow laggard Goldman Sachs Group (ticker: GS)–helped lift the mood on Wall Street, and stocks look poised to notch a second day of gains.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average is up 122.52 points, or 0.51%, to 24,188.11. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite are both 0.24% higher in recent trading.
Midday Movers
Apple (AAPL) is up 1.3% to $154.98 on reports it may partner with Medicare to sell Apple Watches to seniors.
BlackRock (BLK) is up 4.2% to $417.40 after reporting fourth-quarter earnings. Although the money manager’s bottom line missed expectations, the company raised its dividend 5% and saw record inflows. A prankster also spoofed CEO Larry Fink’s annual letter to shareholders.
Concho Resources (CXO) is up 0.8% to$123.42 after Barclays upgraded the energy explorer to Overweight.
Goldman Sachs is up 7.4% to $193.22 after reporting better-than-expected fourth-quarter earnings .
